components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a step.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: One account inside the pinned live ledger.
components.css: .ds-acct { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid #e1e7ef; color: #0b2545; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-amt { text-align: right; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-acct small { font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #4f6079; }

narrative.overview: A payments page in the familiar fintech style, played straight, at a standard meant to sit credibly beside Stripe and Wise. The convention is deliberate: the familiar frame lets the live results be the interesting thing. Nothing decorative competes with a real response the visitor just caused.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, deep navy ink, one violet accent
One elevated surface: the live ledger, pinned for the whole story
Large, tightly set headlines and tabular figures
Results stated in words, with a drawn icon

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Green and red mean paid and refused, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state pairs its colour with a drawn tick or cross, and a word nearby.

dos: Do show only figures that came from an API response.
Do use mono only for real technical data.
Do keep "Fake money" visible on the page.
donts: Don't use a label above a heading.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons; use the drawn icon set.
Don't copy another company's logo, name or marks. The bar is their craft, not their identity.
